text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Immediately following the Oka Sho,<n>the
overwhelming cheers of the<n>crowd pull Mejiro
Dober into a<n>traumatizing flashback.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Suppressing her tremors the best she<n>can, Mejiro
Dober continues to<n>desperately train for the
Japanese<n>Oaks. I can tell something is off<n>though...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, having noticed the<n>change in
Mejiro Dober's behavior,<n>Air Groove asks me if
she can talk to<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Clueless as to how I can help Mejiro<n>Dober
myself, I give Air Groove my<n>permission.
